title: Giants to host Cowboys on Sunday Night Football in Week 1 of 2026 NFL season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants to host Cowboys on Sunday Night Football in Week 1 of 2026 NFL season
sources.description: John Harbaugh to get NFC East rivalry experience in first game as Giants' head coach, as New York will host the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday Night Football to open the 2026 NFL season.
